source: Black Clover S02E04 episode, from 500 s (stream copy, starts on a keyframe)
convention: frame n = first frame of new shot, 0-based decode order

hard_cuts.note: wide shot is covered by a dark cloak passing in front of camera (224-233, almost black); new shot (robes, tilt up to man in white) starts at 234
new shot (man in light burst) starts on a near-white flash frame that fades over 2091-2096
abrupt cut from full white (end of fade-to-white 2456-2468, white hold to 2480) to dark room

dissolves.note: cross-fade from dark swirl/streak shot to symmetric figure/emblem shot
jewel close-up flares/fades to full white (white hold 2468-2480, then hard cut 2481)
room shot fades to full white (white hold 2557-2589)
fade-in from white to gloved hand / jewel shot
fast post-production transition through white (letterbox bars also go white): 3356 is a single half-blend of the old shot with white, 3357-3358 full white, new shot fades in from white 3359-3367

ambiguous.why: hand close-up (2061-2087) abruptly darkens to near-black while a dark hair/cloak silhouette sweeps in from the right; faint palm creases stay visible at the same place, so most likely the same shot occluded/darkened rather than a new setup. The real new shot starts at the hard cut 2091.

man collapses forward, animated on threes (holds at 2790, 2793, 2796): framing content changes a lot each step (back of head, then arm of blond man, then blond hair), but the belt buckles stay at the same screen position, so probably one continuous shot (2741-2798) rather than cuts.

method: All 38 filmstrips (frames 0-3702) viewed in order; every candidate shot change and every busy passage zoomed frame-by-frame at 320 px with frames.py (220-241, 878-897, 1008-1031, 1040-1063, 1154-1203, 1606-1629, 1660-1683, 1715-1738, 2080-2099, 2450-2473, 2536-2559, 2584-2607, 2786-2809, 3352-3371); every hard cut verified on triplets.py sheets (n-2, n-1, n, n+1) with n-1 in the old shot and n in the new one. Metric candidates used only as hints. Done by eye, independent of any detector.
notable_non_cuts: 13-56 mouth animation (many metric candidates); 57-122 slow tilt from hair to eye; 224-233 dark cloak passes in front of the lens before the cut at 234; 883-889 fast tilt/pull-back from belt to face inside one shot; 955-980 blue light floods the same shot (colour change, no cut); 1000-1068 continuous crane/rotating move (feet -> body -> hair, with dark shadow shapes 1046-1068); 1157-1188 swirling dark streak effect (many candidates); 1612-1615 woman lifts her head and raises a hand in the same setup (big pose change, same wall background), then dark smoke covers her 1616-1648; 1650-1720 pan across robed figures with purple smoke; 1721-1780 slow pan on robes/floor; 2088-2090 hand darkens under a silhouette (see ambiguous); 2091-2096 white flash fading inside the new shot; 2145-2178 glow flicker on the two faces; 2600-2700 slow move on the gloved hand with lighting change; 2741-2798 man coughs blood and collapses (see ambiguous 2790); 2799-2876 pan from silhouette to pillar; 3400-3449 blond hair enters the foreground of the same shot; 3450-3551 tilt up from hands to blond face; 3552-3635 hair blowing in wind (many small candidates).
annotator: Claude agent, by eye on contact sheets (2026-10-31); independent of any detector
